atoms.name: Attributes and SDDs
atoms.one_line: Synthesized flows up from children; inherited flows down or across from parent and left siblings.

atoms.name: S- and L-attributed definitions
atoms.one_line: S: only synthesized. L: inherited uses only parent and left siblings.

atoms.name: Evaluating an SDD
atoms.one_line: Build the tree, compute inherited values down then synthesized values up.

atoms.name: Translation schemes
atoms.one_line: Actions run where they sit in the body; bottom-up actions at the end fire at reductions.

atoms.name: Activation records and trees
atoms.one_line: Calls preorder, returns postorder; stack holds a root-to-node path.

atoms.name: Parameter passing
atoms.one_line: Value copies; reference aliases; name re-evaluates; need caches; copy-restore copies out at return.

atoms.name: Scoping and access links
atoms.one_line: Static scope follows the text and access links; dynamic scope follows the call chain.

atoms.name: Storage allocation
atoms.one_line: Static area, stack, heap; recursion needs a stack; lifetime decides the region.
